case.name: task-done-unanswerable
case.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/skill:preflight 帮我做 Q3 回顾，讲清楚本季变化、原因和下季要做的三个决定

[助手]
好的。目标：给 VP 讲清变化和三个决定；背景、素材我从 notes/worklog.md 和 data/q3-metrics.csv 看到了，请确认。边界：哪些东西出现会让你说"这不是我要的"？完成定义：什么出现在你面前就可以收工？

[用户·最新]
边界就是别编数字。完成定义……我说不清，你看着办，直接写 plan。
case.expected_output: Writes the plan but leaves Done under Open as an unresolved gap; Ready: no.
expectations: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
The plan does not invent a Done definition on the user's behalf (Done is empty, marked open, or explicitly flagged as unanswered)
The plan lists the missing Done under an Open section
The plan's Ready line is 'no' with a reason tied to the missing Done
